# DropBot - AI Chatbot Builder
> Build intelligent AI chatbots with drag and drop. No coding required. Create custom conversational flows, embed on any website, and engage visitors 24/7.

## About
DropBot is a no-code AI chatbot builder that lets you create custom conversational flows with drag-and-drop. Features include:
- Drag-and-drop flow builder with multiple node types (message, options, condition, API call, input capture)
- Embed widget with popup, inline, and slide-in modes
- AI-powered responses using OpenAI or local fallback
- Customizable themes and branding
- Usage-based plans from Free to Business
- Embeddable across any website with one line of code

## Pricing
- **Free**: 1 chatbot, 10 nodes, 500 chats/month
- **Pro** ($29/mo): 5 chatbots, 50 nodes, 5,000 chats/month
- **Business** ($99/mo): Unlimited chatbots, unlimited nodes, unlimited chats
